description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing LXC containers within the WPEFramework project, including container iteration, configuration, and administration.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces of an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container, providing methods to control and query its state.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for LXC container settings.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing LXC containers, providing creation and logging functionalities.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Provides memory information of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Provides processor information of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing container by name.
